sections.content:
From 1 July 2026 our OOSH tender application process has changed. For more information about the key changes please refer to the recent briefing link below:

Briefing 30th April 2026

It is recommended that all OOSH providers watch the Out of School Hours Care - Industry Briefings for some top tips on how to submit a high quality OOSH tender application, the briefings were held on 19 June 2024 and 11 December 2024 and attached below.

A recording of the briefings is available via the following links:

Briefing 19th June 2024

Briefing 11th December 2024

The RFT document pack also includes the "RFT Out of School Hours Care - Guide for Tendering," which provides additional information to assist in completing the tender response.
